rules.name: Warehouse Object Names Must Use Approved Pattern
rules.description: Returns object names violating schema/table/view/procedure naming conventions. WARNING: This rule was AI-generated and is untested.

sqlquery: SELECT s.name + '.' + o.name AS ObjectName FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON o.schema_id=s.schema_id WHERE (o.type='U' AND o.name NOT LIKE 'dim[_]%' AND o.name NOT LIKE 'fact[_]%' AND o.name NOT LIKE 'bridge[_]%' AND o.name NOT LIKE 'stg[_]%') OR (o.type='V' AND o.name NOT LIKE 'v[_]%' AND o.name NOT LIKE 'vw[_]%') OR (o.type='P' AND o.name NOT LIKE 'usp[_]%')
